settings.title: Settings

settings.origin.saved: Origin saved — the wire now targets this origin.
settings.origin.invalid: Refused: only loopback origins (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1) are allowed.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: The kernel's own numbers, read live over the typed wire.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Hybrid semantic + lexical search over your corpus.
search.empty: No results. Different words may reach further.
search.error: The search failed. Is the kernel running?
recall.title: Recall
recall.subtitle: Deterministic recall with calibrated abstention.
recall.empty: Nothing recalled. Rephrase or store more first.
recall.error: The recall failed. Is the kernel running?
recall.abstain: Low confidence — recall stopped rather than guess. Nothing was invented.
recall.trace.title: Recall trace
recall.trace.subtitle: The stored decision path for trace {id}. The query is a hash — never raw text.
recall.trace.not_found: No trace is stored for this id.
recall.trace.error: The trace could not be read. Is the kernel running?
decisions.list.title: Decision Explorer
decisions.list.subtitle: Newest-first decision-run summaries. The kernel supports only limit and run_id.
decisions.list.limit.label: Rows
decisions.list.run_id.label: Workflow run ID (optional)
decisions.list.empty: No decision runs were returned for this page.
decisions.list.unauthorized: Authentication is required to list decision runs.
decisions.list.forbidden: This principal cannot list decision runs.
decisions.list.not_found: The requested decision-run page was not found.
decisions.list.conflict: The decision-run listing conflicts with the current kernel state.
decisions.list.bad_request: Choose a limit from 1 to 50 and a valid run ID.
decisions.list.malformed: The kernel returned a decision-run page that could not be verified.
decisions.list.network: The decision-run page could not be reached.
decisions.list.server: The kernel could not complete the decision-run listing.
decisions.detail.title: Decision trace {id}
decisions.detail.subtitle: Digest/reference evidence; raw query and evidence text are not stored.
decisions.detail.invalid: This trace id is not a valid non-negative integer.
decisions.detail.not_found: No decision trace is stored for this id.
decisions.detail.unauthorized: Authentication is required to read this decision trace.
decisions.detail.forbidden: This principal cannot read this decision trace.
decisions.detail.conflict: The decision trace conflicts with the current kernel state.
decisions.detail.network: The decision trace could not be reached.
decisions.detail.malformed: The decision trace failed runtime verification.
decisions.detail.server: The kernel could not complete the decision trace read.
decisions.detail.unknown: The decision trace read was refused.
decisions.detail.no_stages: No completed stage records are stored.
decisions.detail.raw_omitted: Raw response exceeded the 1 MiB capture ceiling; download omitted.
decisions.replay.title: Replay diff
decisions.replay.notice: The original execution bundle is not stored. Supply config, rules, and input transiently to request a data-only replay.
decisions.replay.required: Supply every required field. Nothing is prefilled or reconstructed.
decisions.replay.invalid: Config and rules must be JSON objects; question fields must be valid.
decisions.replay.409: Config hash mismatch: the supplied config does not match the stored trace.
decisions.replay.400: The replay request was refused as invalid.
decisions.replay.403: This principal cannot replay this trace.
decisions.replay.404: The trace or workflow run is no longer available.
decisions.replay.network: The replay request could not be reached.
decisions.replay.malformed: The replay report failed runtime verification.
decisions.replay.server: The kernel could not complete replay.
decisions.replay.cleared: Transient bundle cleared; re-enter inputs for another replay.
